templates.why_chosen: The floor case for two-panel: just 6 components and 2 flows, monochrome except two red latency numbers (10-100ns vs 250-2000ns), proving a single colour contrast can carry the entire argument.
templates.what_to_learn: Keep both panels identical in structure (CPU/cache stack over memory) and spend your only colour on the one number that changes: the access latency in red beside the arrow it labels.
